content: In the other auxiliary prediction module, a sequence of the low-level distant representation vectors is generated and some tokens are dropped. This sequence of vectors is also input into the Softmax function, just as in the first auxiliary prediction module, and the output is another probability distribution, which is the second auxiliary prediction, as shown in auxdistant.
